_doc: European Assault texture table (our own; keys are the disc's 4-char texture SHAPE names, values reference textures of the player's own MOHAA install / the mod's paks). noupscale = textures with lettering or fine print that ESRGAN would garble (DECISIONS 'ESRGAN is for photos and text, not chrome'). Same schema as fl_texmap.json.

_noupscale_reasons.p71q: radio panel with dials and labels

SAZk.reason: the frozen river (23% of the level's surface area): EA 256px blue-grey streaked ice; HD Project frozenriver is 1024px, the same streaked river ice, same cold blue-grey tone, no artefacts

NMVX.reason: the main snow layer of EA's two-layer terrain (top layer on 6 terrain blends): EA 256px plain white snow; HD Project forstsnow (Spearhead winter set) is 1024px light snow with soft drift relief, same white-blue tone; vertex light and EA's blend weights stay on top

_additive_reasons.mkoh: orange-to-black gradient fire-light card inside the burning house (cell 100); EA draws it additively, opaque it showed as a rusty board in the roof hole (visual QA 2026-11-09)
_additive_reasons.wsPb: red-to-black gradient light card, same kind
